construction_context.selection: First canonical retained v1 LLM proposal; no v2 outcomes or allocations used.
construction_context.scope: Variables and dependencies initialize from an earlier LLM-generated proposal. Operational states/references are regenerated against the new transcript context, all nonroot mechanisms are newly proposed, and dependency retractions remain possible. This is conditional refinement, not successful fresh variable/dependency discovery.
construction_context.evidence_policy: The prior is an unverified proposal, never retrieved evidence. No old equation, source score, or mechanism description enters generation.

selection: Fresh completion preferred; otherwise separately labeled conditional refinement. No selection by outcomes, attribution or source scores.
